message.jaymospowers.zfighter_royale_ope: A last-one-standing tournament opens at %s! Step into the ring of light at %s, %s within %s minutes to enter. Everyone fights at once; the last one in the ring wins.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_royale_rea: Hold your ground. The fight begins in a moment.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_royale_beg: The last-one-standing fight at %s begins with %s fighters!
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_royale_cha: %s is the last one standing at %s!
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_bracket.ste: Step into the ring of light to enter.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_bracket.roy: Out of the ring, beaten down, downed or knocked out: you are out. The ring closes in.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_realism_on: Realistic mode is on: Z Fighter fights are harsher (ki and blows hurt more both ways, ki comes back slower, flight costs more, healing is slower in a fight, limbs break more).
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_realism_se: Realistic mode is now on (saved in config/jaymospowers-server.properties).
Realistic mode is now off (saved in config/jaymospowers-server.properties).
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_r: Hold the line: stay within %s blocks of the town (the wall of light). Outside it for %s seconds and you forfeit your share.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_p: Prize, shared by how much you hurt them: up to %s TP (Z Fighters) or %s levels of experience.
Also up to %s emeralds, and %s x %s and %s hermit beans each.
The tyrant has a %s%% chance of dropping a pair of bonding earrings for whoever hurts him most.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_s: If %s falls, every defender loses %s standing with its realm.
The %s at %s: wave %s of %s, %s soldiers standing, %s defenders.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_j: You stand with the defenders of %s.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_f: You left the line. Your share of the prize is forfeit.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_l: You are leaving the line! Back in %s...
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_f: You left the line, so you have no share of the prize.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_n: You did too little against the invaders to earn a share.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_p: Your share: %s TP, %s emeralds, %s x %s and %s hermit beans.
Your share: %s levels of experience, %s emeralds, %s x %s and %s hermit beans.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_w: The %s is broken at %s! %s defenders share the prize.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_f: %s has fallen to the %s! The invaders withdraw with their plunder.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_invasion_s: You failed to hold %s. You lost standing with its realm.
